topics: Product roadmap and Redwood Optimize launch plan
transcript:
Header:
Date: 2025-10-08 10:00 PDT
Duration: ~62 minutes
Attendees: Avery Collins, Maya Patel, Ethan Li, Jordan Kim, Priya Rao + whole company (Zoom)

Summary: Avery opens with company health, Maya walks product, Ethan covers eng wins, Q&A follows.

00:00 Avery Collins: Good morning, uh, everyone thanks for joining, we've got a packed all-hands today so we'll keep it tight, couple of big updates on revenue and product.
00:14 Jordan Kim: Quick housekeeping, Q&A at the end, please drop questions in Q&A panel.
00:22 Avery Collins: Alright, Q3 numbers, um we finished the quarter with 38% YoY revenue growth (approx), churn continued to stay low, net retention 112, those numbers are rough, but directionally solid. We saw a couple of big renewals in the dedicated space which helped offset slower self-serve.
00:48 Maya Patel: On product, Q4 focus is on Redwood Optimize GA and a more opinionated defaults surface for batching/caching. We're shipping an early beta of the cost analysis dashboard next week. Note: the Optimize name might change in docs, we'll reconcile.
01:12 Ethan Li: Engineering highlights: we've landed the KV cache rewrite, which gives about 15-20% token cost reduction on common seq lengths; also reduced tail latency on dedicated instances by about 30% in internal tests. Some of the numbers are still preliminary, please treat as internal.
01:36 Avery Collins: On private deployments, we completed two POCs with regulated customers, both on-prem installs; the install automation still has rough edges, installer sometimes hangs on network step - team is on it.
01:52 Priya Rao: People update: we added 18 hires in Q3 across eng and sales, rolling out updated PTO and parental leave policies; we'll publish the handbook update this week.
02:10 Maya Patel: Product roadmap bullets: 1) Redwood Optimize GA (cost/perf tooling), 2) Streaming and tool-calling improvements, 3) Model catalog revamp with verified perf profiles and quantization recommendations. We'll publish a short blog about verified models and guidance by early Nov.
02:38 Ethan Li: Quick technical note: the runtime now does kernel selection that better matches sequence length distributions; we saw big wins on MLP-heavy layers for small context windows - oh and we improved GPU memory utilization on A100/MI250. There were some transcribe mistakes in our internal doc, like V P C spelled out oddly in notes.
03:02 Avery Collins: A bit on go-to-market - Jordan?
03:07 Jordan Kim: Sales is ramping outbound into mid-market; pilots for Dedicated are converting at better rates, especially when we can guarantee latency SLOs. We still get questions about logs/data residency and SOC 2, so security playbook is important.
03:28 Maya Patel: Also demo/benchmark plan: we'll run a public benchmark comparing default Redwood Optimize settings vs standard hosted configs; this is to show latency/cost tradeoffs for customers. Reminder: benchmarking is tricky - try not to leak internal model weights or customer data when publishing.
03:52 Audience question (Chat): Are we extending credits for startups?
04:00 Jordan Kim: Yes, we extended a limited credits program tied to usage and referral; details in the growth channel.
04:14 Audience question (Linda, Sales): Any update on integration with partner X?
04:20 Ethan Li: Partner integration is on track; we have an initial connector for their infra but still need to validate throughput under real traffic.
04:34 Avery Collins: Ok, now org changes: we promoted two directors in Eng and combined two product squads to better focus on serving runtime and Optimize. This means some folks will see new managers, and we'll share org chart after this call.
04:56 Priya Rao: Hiring update: priority is infra/serving and sales engineering. If you have referrals, please submit via the portal for the referral bonus.
05:10 Maya Patel: Demo preview - short screen share (described): new Optimize dashboard shows cost per 1M tokens, suggested quantization per model, and expected latency impact. There's a note: some of the labels in the mock say "Redwood Dedicatd" instead of Dedicated - will fix before public doc.
05:38 Ethan Li: Tech deep dive snippet: continuous batching improvements reduce larger request spikes; we're also improving prefix caching heuristics. There's a known bug where KV cache warmup is slower on very long contexts, team tracking as TICKET-1287.
06:02 Audience question (Dev): What's the timeline for GA on Optimize?
06:08 Maya Patel: Targeting GA late November, with beta invite list starting mid-October. We'll share the feature gate and docs next week.
06:20 Audience question (Eng): Any improvements planned for on-prem installer?
06:25 Ethan Li: Yes, shipping an improved installer (better network retry/agent rollback) in two weeks; tickets after that for edge cases.
06:40 Audience question (Finance): Are we revising pricing?
06:45 Avery Collins: No big pricing changes planned for now; we're experimenting with different bundling for Dedicated, more details in the finance channel this week.
06:58 Audience question (All): How do we prioritize technical debt vs feature work?
07:04 Ethan Li: We added a quarterly tech-debt sprint and ownership model, plus measured impact on latency/cost as part of the roadmap.
07:20 Maya Patel: Quick customer story: demoed Dedicated to a fintech pilot and reduced p99 latency below their SLO with autoscale tweaks, they were impressed with routing policies and fallback to smaller model variant under load.
07:44 Audience question (Legal): Any update on SOC 2 timeline?
07:50 Priya Rao: We're in the middle of the SOC 2 Type I readiness; auditor work scheduled for Q4, Type II expected mid-next year.
08:06 Avery Collins: Alright folks, open Q&A rapid fire, try to keep to short questions.
08:15 Audience Q: Can we have more town halls with product?
08:20 Maya Patel: Yes, we'll do biweekly product office hours starting next week.
08:28 Audience Q: Any internal retros on the August outage?
08:32 Ethan Li: Postmortem published - root cause in autoscaler config; we've added automated canary tests and rollback hooks.
08:48 Jordan Kim: Final note on customers - top-of-funnel is stable, conversion on Dedicated is biggest lever for ARR this quarter.
09:02 Avery Collins: Thanks everyone, recap: org chart and handbook update 10/15, Optimize beta invites mid-Oct, installer patch in two weeks. Action items posted in the ops channel.
09:22 Avery Collins: Meeting adjourned.

Notes: occasional transcription glitches (e.g., "KV cache" as "K V cache", "Dedicated" spelled oddly), timestamps approximate.
